verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a Git hosting service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only says Gitea has an API ("Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks"), and it never describes an explorable or interactive reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe found 404s at every candidate path on docs.gitea.com, and the SDK and CLI mentions are adjacent building blocks, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
